versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Java code format review skill.

- Reviews AI-generated Java code for alignment with team formatting and naming conventions.
- Enforces rules from the Alibaba Java Development Manual at [Mandatory], [Recommended], and [Reference] levels.
- Covers naming, structure, comments, and code style (not functional correctness).
- Provides detailed checklists for naming conventions, constant definitions, code formatting, and OOP practices.
- Clearly outlines common AI code style pitfalls and how to resolve them.
